title: Spider only
subtitle: Mainly exterior. Internal only if activity is present.

sections.body: Mainly exterior. Internal only if activity noted: skirtings & cornices.

sections.heading: Products
rows: Skirting boards if activity present. Cornices if heavy spider activity. HIGH PRESSURE: extra light on cornices, no dripping, clean start/stop.
All exterior via pump sprayer off truck. Bifenthrin instead of Fipronil for spider jobs.

sections.heading: Key spider focus areas
rows: Full length. Priority area for spiders.
Common web locations. Treat all frames thoroughly.
Joints, beam ends, undisturbed corners under deck.
Ceiling corners, wall/ceiling junctions, undisturbed areas.
Adjacent to structure: treat soil & plant bases.
Light Rega spray if heavy spider activity inside.
Light Rega spray if activity present indoors.

sections.heading: Exterior: all areas
sections.body: Pump sprayer off truck, Bifenthrin. All walls, eaves, windows, doors, soil, gardens, retaining walls, fence line, deck/pergola, garage exterior.

sections.heading: Job complete when
items: Full exterior done: eaves, walls, windows, gardens, deck
Internal skirtings & cornices done if activity present
Untreated areas noted on job report
Customer briefed on re-entry & what to expect

items.a: Yes. Synthetic pyrethroids, plant-derived, low-tox. Less than supermarket fly spray. Targeted application. Safe once dry, about an hour. [Mitch to confirm this wording]
Normal. Takes 2 to 3 weeks. You may still see dead spiders as the product works. Still active after 3 weeks? Call us, we'll come back.
Exterior around 3 to 6 months depending on weather. Every 6 to 12 months recommended. [Mitch to confirm: the onboarding pack script says exterior about 3 months and interior about 6 months]

sections.body: Bifenthrin on exterior for spider jobs, NOT Fipronil. Extra light on cornices with Rega. Note all untreated areas on job report.
